item.command: /bin/bash -lc "find . -path './.git' -prune -o -path './.agent-input' -prune -o -type d -print; printf '\\n---PACKAGE---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' package.json; printf '\\n---README---\\n'; sed -n '1,260p' README.md; printf '\\n---RUBRIC---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' .agent-input/engineering-assessment/references/severity-rubric.md 2>&1 || true; printf '\\n---CHECKS---\\n'; npm test 2>&1; npm run build 2>&1; npm run lint 2>&1; npm run typecheck 2>&1; npm audit 2>&1"

/bin/bash -lc "find . -path './.git' -prune -o -path './.agent-input' -prune -o -type d -print; printf '\\n---PACKAGE---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' package.json; printf '\\n---README---\\n'; sed -n '1,260p' README.md; printf '\\n---RUBRIC---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' .agent-input/engineering-assessment/references/severity-rubric.md 2>&1 || true; printf '\\n---CHECKS---\\n'; npm test 2>&1; npm run build 2>&1; npm run lint 2>&1; npm run typecheck 2>&1; npm audit 2>&1"

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in src/*.js test/*.js; do echo "--- $f ---"; nl -ba "$f"; done; printf '"'\\n---STATUS---\\n'; git status --short; printf '\\n---TREE---\\n'; find src test -type f -maxdepth 2 -print | sort; printf '\\n---PACKAGE METADATA---\\n'; npm ls --depth=0 2>&1"

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in src/*.js test/*.js; do echo "--- $f ---"; nl -ba "$f"; done; printf '"'\\n---STATUS---\\n'; git status --short; printf '\\n---TREE---\\n'; find src test -type f -maxdepth 2 -print | sort; printf '\\n---PACKAGE METADATA---\\n'; npm ls --depth=0 2>&1"

/bin/bash -lc "test -f ASSESSMENT.md && rg -n '"'^## (Scope and approach|What I ran|Findings|Unconfirmed / Requires Investigation|Strengths|Key Risks|Priority Order|Coverage Gaps)'"' ASSESSMENT.md; printf '\\n---FILES---\\n'; find . -path './.git' -prune -o -path './.agent-input' -prune -o -type f -print | sort; printf '\\n---SOURCE CHECKSUMS---\\n'; sha256sum package.json README.md src/*.js test/*.js"
